 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER Heard and perused the case diary.

(1) This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail in relation to Crime No.108/2023, registered at Police Station- Kshipra, District- Indore, under sections 363, 366, 366(A), 376(2)(n) and 450 of IPC and 5-L/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 04.03.2023.
(2) Allegation against the applicant is that he has committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix.
(3) Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
It is further submitted that the statements of the prosecutrix as well as parents of the prosecutrix have already been recorded before the trial Court and they have turned hostile.
The applicant is in custody since 04.03.2023 and the conclusion of trial will take sufficient time.
On the aforesaid grounds, he prays for grant of bail.

sentences.text: (4) Learned counsel for the state has opposed the application by submitting that the applicant has committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix.

(5) Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, on a perusal of the material available on record including the case diary as well as the statements of the witnesses, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

(6) It is directed that the applicant/accused be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
(7).

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE VD Ritesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93969494/
